description: Canonical path boundary of the reqQuest Framework toolkit (ADR-TOOLKIT-001 D1). The GitHub Release asset `raac-toolkit-<version>.tar.gz` attached to every `toolkit-v<version>` tag contains exactly the files matched by `boundary` and not by `exclude`, packed under a single top-level `raac-toolkit-<version>/` directory. `.reqq/validator/reqq_validate_stdlib.py` reads this same file to compute the hashes it records in `.reqq/toolkit.lock`. The boundary must stay self-sufficient: whatever the shipped validator and the shipped CI workflow need in order to run green on a fresh extract has to be inside it.
